_doc: OGRL-20261007-006 (switched off). Forks run38 at switch time onto the 12 horde maps (t_horde_301..312; t_horde_held_401 is never trained on). Opponent count unlocks 3 -> 7 on the existing gate (60% at the current max), and the armed ladder climbs B1 -> C on its deterministic gate. 12 engines, not 20: every engine carries up to 8 characters, so per-engine memory roughly doubles, and engine count must stay a multiple of the 12-map corpus. Question: how far up the 1vN ladder does the agent get, armed and unarmed (robust r1 horde cells)?
purpose: OGRL-20261007-006 run40: run38 fork, horde maps, opponents up to 1v7, armed ladder B1..C
